g.text: 1. Revenue Concentration: Technology hardware generates 45% of gross revenue with highest profit margin (24.5%).
2. Regional Growth Opportunity: European market demonstrated 24% YoY growth driven by enterprise software licensing.
3. Seasonality Impact: Q4 generates 38% of total yearly orders due to holiday promotions and year-end enterprise budgets.
• Inventory Optimization: Increase Q3 stocking levels for Technology products in West Coast hubs by 15%.
• Customer Retention: Re-engage underperforming APAC accounts using targeted volume discount packages.
• DAX Forecasting Model: Deploy automated weekly refresh to catch regional inventory bottlenecks early.
